The review has been completed, and the audit report has been written to [02_REVIEW.md](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/02_REVIEW.md).

### Summary of Actions & Findings

1. **Test Execution**:
   - Ran `python3 -m unittest public_test.py` (1 test executed, passing `test_empty_input`).
2. **Audit of [`sgf_parsing.py`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py)**:
   - **Algorithmic & Tokenization Flaw**: [`_parse_property_identifier`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py#L90-L102) fails on mixed-case property identifiers (e.g. `Aa[t]`) by prematurely truncating the token at `'a'`, causing [`_parse_node`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py#L70-L89) to raise `ValueError("value missing")` rather than `ValueError("property must be in uppercase")`. All-lowercase property identifiers raise `ValueError("property missing")` instead of `ValueError("property must be in uppercase")`.
   - **Delimiter Error Mismatch**: In [`_parse_node`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py#L78-L79), property keys missing delimiter brackets (e.g. `(;A)`) raise `ValueError("value missing")` instead of `ValueError("properties without delimiter")`.
   - **Tree With No Nodes**: In [`_parse_tree`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py#L49-L50), empty trees (`"()"`) raise `ValueError("tree missing")` instead of `ValueError("tree with no nodes")`.
   - **Boundary & Escape Compliance**: Bounds checking on `self.position` and text unescaping rules (newlines after `\`, tab conversion to space, literal escape preserving) conform to [`README.md`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/README.md).
   - **Performance & Usability Traps**: [`SgfTree.__eq__`](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/sgf_parsing.py#L6-L22) uses recursion across child chains and can trigger `RecursionError` on long single-child node sequences ($\ge 1000$ nodes); missing `__repr__` hinders test failure readability.
3. **Report**:
   - Detailed findings, complete test matrices, and concrete required code fixes have been recorded in [02_REVIEW.md](file:///private/var/folders/z3/tpy284jj297ck601rpn41r1m0000gp/T/harness_eval_sgf-parsing_arm_b_kn1_gmfm/02_REVIEW.md). No source or test files were modified.
